tabResults.name: The Achiever
tabResults.description: You are action- and result-oriented and focus on the tasks ahead, where performance and productivity are key. You are verbally and socially skilled. You enjoy problem-solving and have high achievement needs. You are good at balancing authority and compassion. You are able to create a favorable environment at your workplace. You focus on every detail of your task and expect the same from others. Your approach to life is optimistic, and you focus on possibilities even in difficult situations. You accept your failures and work towards success.

tabResults.name: The Enthusiast
tabResults.description: You are super creative and fun-loving. You look for all the possibilities and love working on new ideas. You can fill the room with laughter and the desire to live life on your own terms. You are always curious to learn new things and believe in enjoying your life. You can be described as someone who is "full of energy" and life. You are always on the go to create something new and interesting.

tabResults.name: The Logical

You communicate effectively and observe the situation as a whole. You can be described as a "practical" and "fair" person

tabResults.name: The Empath
